| Category = Apple recipes
| Difficulty = 2
}}

{{recipe}} 

== Ingredients ==
* 1 Honeycrisp [[Cookbook:Apple|apple]], cored, peeled, and [[Cookbook:Slicing|sliced]] into 12ths
* ¾ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] [[Cookbook:Bourbon|bourbon]]
* 2 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] unsalted [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]], melted
* 1 tbsp freshly squeezed [[Cookbook:Lemon Juice|lemon juice]]
* ¼ cup white [[Cookbook:Granulated Sugar|granulated sugar]]
* ½ [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] freshly ground [[Cookbook:Allspice|allspice]]
* 2 [[Cookbook:Clove|cloves]], freshly ground
* ½ tsp freshly ground [[Cookbook:Cinnamon|cinnamon]]

== Procedure ==
#Coat apples with butter and lemon.
#Combine sugar, allspice, cloves, and cinnamon. Sprinkle over apples and toss to coat.
#Preheat a small stainless steel [[Cookbook:Skillet|skillet]] over medium high heat. Add apples and [[Cookbook:Sautéing|sauté]] until lightly browned.
#Add bourbon to pan and deglaze. Bring to a [[Cookbook:Boiling|boil]], and cook, stirring occasionally, until apples are fork tender. Serve immediately.
